scripts.predev: node ../../scripts/dev/run-guarded-service-predev.mjs remote-agent "corepack pnpm -C ../.. exec turbo run build --filter=@openmeld/remote-agent"
scripts.dev: dotenv -e ../../.env -o -- sh -c 'pnpm run build && wrangler dev --config dist/openmeld_remote_agent/wrangler.json --persist-to ../../.wrangler-dev-state --inspector-port 19333'
scripts.predev:isolated: node ../../scripts/dev/run-guarded-service-predev.mjs remote-agent "corepack pnpm -C ../.. exec turbo run build --filter=@openmeld/remote-agent"
scripts.dev:prod: dotenv -e ../../.env -o -- sh -c 'pnpm run build && pnpm run build:prod-config && wrangler dev --config dist/openmeld_remote_agent/wrangler.prod.json --persist-to ../../.wrangler-dev-state --inspector-port 19333'
scripts.deploy: pnpm run build:workspace-dependencies && dotenv -e ../../.env -o -- sh -c 'pnpm run build && pnpm run build:prod-config && wrangler deploy --config dist/openmeld_remote_agent/wrangler.prod.json'
scripts.deploy:stg: pnpm run build:workspace-dependencies && pnpm run build && pnpm run build:stg-config && wrangler deploy --config dist/openmeld_remote_agent/wrangler.stg.json
scripts.sync:prod: pnpm run sync:secrets:prod && pnpm run sync:config:prod
scripts.sync:stg: pnpm run sync:secrets:stg && pnpm run sync:config:stg
scripts.cf-typegen: pnpm run build && wrangler types --config dist/openmeld_remote_agent/wrangler.json --env-interface=CloudflareBindings && biome check --write worker-configuration.d.ts && pnpm run typecheck
